name: io.github.Servosity/fortinet-mcp
title: Fortinet MCP
description: Audit every client FortiGate for firmware, SSL-VPN exposure, admin accounts and license expiry.

environmentVariables.name: FORTINET_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your FortiGate's REST API root, e.g. https://203.0.113.10:8443/api/v2.

environmentVariables.name: FORTINET_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: The FortiGate REST API admin token (System > Administrators > Create New > REST API Admin). Use a read-only admin profile.

environmentVariables.name: FORTINET_DEVICES
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Path to a devices.toml listing every FortiGate the fleet, audit and policies hygiene commands check, each with a token_file. Leave blank to check only the FortiGate above.

environmentVariables.name: FORTINET_FMG_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. https://<fortimanager> for the read-only fmg commands. Leave blank if you do not use FortiManager.

environmentVariables.name: FORTINET_FMG_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. API key of a FortiManager REST API admin (FortiManager 7.2.2 or later) for the fmg commands.

environmentVariables.name: FORTINET_CLOUD_API_USER
environmentVariables.description: Optional. FortiCloud IAM API user (with FortiGate Cloud portal permission) for the read-only cloud commands.

environmentVariables.name: FORTINET_CLOUD_API_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Password of the FortiCloud IAM API user. Repeated failed logins lock the FortiCloud account for 15-30 minutes.

environmentVariables.name: FORTINET_CLOUD_REGION
environmentVariables.description: Optional. global (default), us, eu or jp: the region your FortiGates were provisioned in.

environmentVariables.name: FORTINET_CLOUD_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Required only when FortiCloud Organizations are enabled.

environmentVariables.name: FORTINET_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to expose only read-only mirrored tools and refuse any non-GET execute call.

environmentVariables.name: FORTINET_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment); callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport Claude Desktop uses.

environmentVariables.name: FORTINET_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends to your FortiGates. Leave blank to use the built-in one.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Only used when the MCP server is bound to a tenant-gated client profile. This connector registers no tenant-gated source, so leave it blank.
